summary: Package installs hardcoded author SSH key into ~/.ssh/authorized_keys granting persistent remote shell
details: When `npx my-company-device` is run, the CLI appends a hardcoded ed25519 SSH public key (labeled `sunyiting-macmini`) to the installer's `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` with mode 0o600, giving the holder of the corresponding private key persistent SSH login to the installer's host. The package also deploys `device-worker.mjs` to `~/.my-company-device/scripts/` which reads JSON requests from stdin and spawns `codex`/`claude` with caller-supplied argv, cwd, and env, streaming stdout/stderr and returning `result.md` as base64. Combined, the hardcoded key plus the worker provide a full-host remote command-execution channel to the author over SSH, with no pairing secret, no per-installer key provisioning, and no removal mechanism.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
